name: Nomad
description: Nomad is a website template for moving companies, with a three step quote on the first screen, priced packages, an hour by hour moving day plan, a fleet and insurance. An orange accent, deep navy and condensed typography give the website a practical, transport character. Replace the copy, photos, company details, prices and reviews with your own before publishing.
features: Three step quote on the first screen: route, size and date with contact
Packages for flats, houses and offices
Moving day plan, hour by hour
What we move, and what we cannot take
Client reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
